description:
Job Summary
 Synechron is hiring a Java Backend Developer to build and maintain scalable backend applications and APIs. This role supports business goals by delivering reliable, secure, and high-performing services.
 
 Software Requirements
 Required
 Java 8+ 
 Spring Boot , Spring MVC 
 REST APIs 
 Microservices knowledge
 MySQL , familiarity with MongoDB 
 Git 
 Maven or Gradle 
 Basic Docker knowledge
 
 Preferred
 PostgreSQL , Redis 
 Kafka or RabbitMQ 
 Basic cloud exposure: AWS , Azure , or GCP 
 JUnit , Mockito 
 OAuth2 , JWT 
 Kubernetes 
 
 Overall Responsibilities
 Design, develop, and maintain backend applications and APIs
 Integrate with frontend systems and third-party services
 Write clean, reusable, and efficient code
 Conduct code reviews and improve code quality
 Troubleshoot backend issues and optimize performance
 Implement security and data protection measures
 Collaborate with QA, product, and frontend teams
 
 Technical Skills (By Category)
 Programming Languages
 Essential: Java 8+
 Preferred: None
 
 Databases / Data Management
 Essential: MySQL, MongoDB familiarity
 Preferred: PostgreSQL, Redis
 
 Cloud Technologies
 Essential: None
 Preferred: AWS, Azure, or GCP basics
 
 Frameworks and Libraries
 Essential: Spring Boot, Spring MVC
 Preferred: JUnit, Mockito
 
 Development Tools and Methodologies
 Essential: Git, Maven/Gradle, REST, microservices, Agile
 Preferred: Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins
 
 Security Protocols
 Essential: Basic application security practices
 Preferred: OAuth2, JWT
 
 Experience Requirements
 5+ years of Java backend development experience
 Experience building APIs and backend services
 Experience in microservices or service-based environments
 Equivalent practical experience may also be considered
 
 Day-to-Day Activities
 Develop backend features and APIs
 Maintain and improve existing services
 Review code and resolve issues
 Write tests and technical documentation
 Join stand-ups, sprint planning, and team collaboration sessions
 
 Qualifications
 Required
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field
 or equivalent practical experience
 
 Preferred
 Relevant Java certifications
 
 Professional Competencies
 Problem-solving and analytical skills
 Clear communication and teamwork
 Ownership of assigned work
 Adaptability to changing priorities
 Time management and attention to quality
 S​ YNECHRON’S DIVERSITY & INCLUSION STATEMENT
